findings.summary: The new __setstate__ expects a dict state and can't load pickles from the old tuple-based __getstate__, so old pickles silently load as half-initialized objects (or raise TypeError if a name matches a value); it should handle both tuple and dict formats.
The new module-level test class `A` has a overly generic name in a shared test module, and `parametrize("cls", [A])` is pointless with a single value.
